from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
from decimal import Decimal
from ledgerly.models import Payment
from ledgerly.reporting import payments_between
from ledgerly.errors import BillingError

UTC = timezone.utc
a = Payment("a","inv",Decimal("1"),created_at=datetime(2026,1,2,tzinfo=UTC))
b = Payment("b","inv",Decimal("1"),created_at=datetime(2026,1,5,tzinfo=UTC))
# half-open: end exclusive
print(payments_between([a,b], datetime(2026,1,2,tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026,1,5,tzinfo=UTC)) == [a])
# start inclusive
print(payments_between([a,b], datetime(2026,1,2,tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026,1,6,tzinfo=UTC)) == [a,b])
# non-UTC aware boundary normalizes
tz2 = timezone(timedelta(hours=2))
print(payments_between([a,b], datetime(2026,1,2,2,tzinfo=tz2), datetime(2026,1,5,2,tzinfo=tz2)) == [a])
# naive raises
for args in [(datetime(2026,1,1), datetime(2026,1,3,tzinfo=UTC)), (datetime(2026,1,1,tzinfo=UTC), datetime(2026,1,3))]:
    try:
        payments_between([a], *args)
        print("FAIL no raise")
    except BillingError as e:
        print("raised", e.code)
EOF"}
